culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Reisuke Inaba, by the way. He was the one suggesting his colleagues to check on Kabumoto’s well-being as an excuse to put the handkerchief under the door, and put the rubber ball between the door stop and the floor. The size of the rubber ball MUST be the same or slightly larger than the gap between that door stop and the floor so that it can get stuck between the door and the floor due to friction. Inaba was also the one to open the door, which was stuck due to the rubber ball, and would have pointed out the handkerchief to make everyone believe Kabumoto’s dead body is blocking
